title: Halo Dental button
description: Sharp 4px-radius 40px-tall action buttons set in regular 400 weight: primary international orange with black text, solid contrast white, 1px hairline outline, warm stone muted, translucent 40×40 square icon/locale buttons, and a split play button with a tinted left icon box.
notes: All button labels use font-normal (400) with zero shadow, matching Halo Dental's industrial-design typography
The play variant renders the split video trigger seen on the mobile hero (40×40 tinted icon compartment + label)
